name: enable_module
label: Enable module
help_text: Show or hide this module on the page.

name: custom_id
label: Custom ID
help_text: Replaces the auto-generated module ID used in HTML and for CSS/JS targeting. Leave blank to use the default.

name: custom_classes
label: Custom Classes
help_text: Additional CSS classes for styling this module.

name: logo_group
label: Logo
help_text: Uses the logo from the brand kit by default. Add a logo image below to override with a custom logo.

children.name: logo_image
children.label: Logo Image (override)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use the logo from the brand kit. Add an image to use a custom logo instead.

children.name: max_dropdown_levels
children.label: Max Dropdown Levels
children.help_text: Number of menu levels that show as dropdowns. 1 level (flat) = one level of submenus; 2–4 = deeper nested dropdowns.

name: mobile_menu_header
label: Mobile Menu Icon
help_text: Icon and layout at the top of the mobile menu drawer. Icon defaults to the brand kit favicon; you can override with a custom image (max 50% width when overridden). Menu links and bottom buttons start below this row.

children.name: icon_override
children.label: Icon (override)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use the brand kit favicon. Add an image to use a custom icon instead (max width 50% when overridden).

children.name: icon_width
children.label: Icon width (px)
children.help_text: Width of the icon/favicon in the mobile menu.

children.name: add_icon
children.label: Add Icon
children.help_text: Enable to add a Font Awesome icon to the button.

children.name: show_in_header_on_mobile
children.label: Show in header on mobile
children.help_text: When on, this button can appear in the mobile header bar. Only the topmost button with this option enabled is shown when the hamburger menu is on.

children.name: show_in_mobile_menu
children.label: Show in mobile menu
children.help_text: When on, this button can appear in the mobile menu drawer header (next to the close button). Only the topmost button with this option enabled is shown.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: Decorative or semantic for accessibility.

name: announcement_bar
label: Announcement Bar
help_text: Optional bar at the very top that slides down after a delay. Close button hides it site-wide for the configured duration.

children.name: announcement_enabled
children.label: Enable Announcement Bar
children.help_text: When enabled, the announcement bar appears at the top after the delay and can be closed. When closed, it stays hidden site-wide for the hide duration.

children.name: announcement_content
children.label: Announcement Content
children.help_text: Rich text content shown in the announcement bar.

children.name: announcement_delay_seconds
children.label: Delay (seconds)
children.help_text: Time in seconds before the announcement bar slides down.

children.name: announcement_hide_duration_hours
children.label: Hide Duration (hours)
children.help_text: After the user closes the bar, how many hours to keep it hidden site-wide.

children.name: announcement_hide_duration_minutes
children.label: Hide Duration (minutes)
children.help_text: After the user closes the bar, how many minutes to keep it hidden site-wide (in addition to hours).

name: top_bar
label: Top Bar
help_text: Layout for the top bar (below announcement bar, above header). Configure in later phases.

children.name: top_bar_layout
children.label: Top Bar Layout
children.help_text: One column, two columns, or none.

children.name: primary_column
children.label: Primary Column (or Single Column)
children.help_text: Content for the single column, or the first column when using two columns.

children.name: primary_content_type
children.label: Content Type
children.help_text: Choose one content type for this column. You cannot mix types.

children.name: primary_column_alignment
children.label: Alignment
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment for the entire column (buttons, text items, or rich text).

children.name: primary_show_on_mobile
children.label: Show on Mobile
children.help_text: Show this column on mobile (SM/XS). When off, column is hidden on small screens.

children.name: primary_column_width
children.label: Column Width (Large screens)
children.help_text: Width of the primary column when using two columns. Secondary fills the rest. Cascades to Tablet unless overridden.

children.name: primary_column_width_md_group
children.label: Override Column Width (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different column width for this breakpoint.

children.name: primary_column_width_md_override
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different width for this breakpoint.

children.name: primary_column_width_md
children.label: Column Width (Tablet)
children.help_text: Width when override is enabled.

children.name: primary_buttons
children.label: Buttons
children.help_text: Add one or more buttons.

children.name: add_icon
children.label: Add Icon
children.help_text: Enable to add a Font Awesome icon to the button.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: Decorative or semantic for accessibility.

children.name: second_column
children.label: Secondary Column
children.help_text: Content for the secondary column when layout is Two Columns.

children.name: second_column_alignment
children.label: Alignment
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment for the entire column (buttons, text items, or rich text).

children.name: add_icon
children.label: Add Icon
children.help_text: Enable to add a Font Awesome icon to the button.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: Decorative or semantic for accessibility.

name: background_video_settings
label: Module Background Video
help_text: Set Background Option to Video in the Style tab first, then choose the video source (file, HubSpot video, or embed) and poster image here. Overlay and base color for video are in the Style tab when Video is selected.

children.name: video_source_type
children.label: Video Type
children.help_text: Choose HubSpot Video (Marketing > Video), a video from the File Manager, or an external embed (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.).

children.name: hubspot_video
children.label: HubSpot Video
children.help_text: Select a video from Marketing > Video. Requires Marketing Video in your HubSpot account.

children.name: video_file
children.label: Video from files
children.help_text: Select a video from the File Manager. Shown as background; autoplay muted and loop. Works on all HubSpot tiers (no Video Management required).

children.name: embed_field
children.label: External Embed
children.help_text: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or other external sources. For autoplay as background, use a URL that includes autoplay and muted if supported.

children.name: poster_image
children.label: Poster Image
children.help_text: Shown before the video loads and as fallback if video fails.

children.name: module_settings
children.label: Module Settings
children.help_text: Spacing (margins and padding) and max module width for the header wrapper.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Adjust margins and padding for the module wrapper. Margin creates space between modules; padding creates space around the module content. Default padding is 25px on all sides. When the module has multiple spacing fields (e.g. Text Box Padding), each applies to its intended target only — see MODULE-SETTINGS-BACKGROUND-STANDARD §1.

children.name: max_module_width
children.label: Max Module Width
children.help_text: Default, Small, Large: Use values from Global theme styles > Containers. Full Width: Content spans the full screen. Custom: Enter a specific pixel value (600–2400).

children.name: max_module_width_custom
children.label: Max Module Width (px)
children.help_text: Custom max width in pixels when Custom is selected above.

children.name: module_background_settings
children.label: Module Background Settings
children.help_text: Configure the module background: Theme Color, Custom Color, Gradient, Image, or Video. All background styling (colors, gradient, image, and for Video the overlay and base color) is in this Style tab. When Video is selected, choose the video source only in the Content tab (Module Background Video).

children.name: background_option
children.label: Background Option
children.help_text: Choose the type of background: Theme Color, Custom Color (hex with opacity), Gradient, Image, or Video. When Video is selected, overlay and base color appear here; choose the video source and poster in the Content tab under Module Background Video.

children.name: background_color_overlay_video
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the video. Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: background_base_color_video
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the video (fallback or before video loads). Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: video_autoplay
children.label: Autoplay
children.help_text: Start playing when the page loads (recommended for background video).

children.name: video_loop
children.label: Loop
children.help_text: Restart the video when it ends.

children.name: video_muted
children.label: Muted
children.help_text: Play without sound (required for autoplay in most browsers).

children.name: video_plays_inline
children.label: Plays inline
children.help_text: Play inline on mobile instead of fullscreen.

children.name: background_image_xl_group
children.label: XL Background Image
children.help_text: Background image settings for XL screens (≥1200px). Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: background_image_xl
children.label: Background Image
children.help_text: Fallback image for smaller breakpoints if not overridden. For retina quality: use 2× the display width (about 2400px at 1200px). Height can match your section—from very short to several hundred pixels—and Background Position helps with focal point.

children.name: background_position_xl
children.label: Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_xl
children.label: Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_xl
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image to adjust contrast for text.

children.name: background_base_color_xl
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image (fallback or for transparent areas).

children.name: background_image_lg_group
children.label: Override Desktop Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for 992px–1199px (LG). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_lg_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_md_group
children.label: Override Tablet Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for 768px–991px (MD). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_md_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_md
children.label: Tablet Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_md
children.label: Tablet Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_md
children.label: Tablet Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_md
children.label: Tablet Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_md
children.label: Tablet Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_sm_group
children.label: Override Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for ≤767px (SM). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_sm_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color_overlay_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_base_color_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color. For a custom hex color, use Background Option = Custom Color instead.

children.name: background_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Theme Color is set to Custom.

children.name: background_custom
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Solid color with opacity when Background Option is Custom.

children.name: background_gradient
children.label: Background Gradient
children.help_text: Gradient colors and direction when Background Option is Gradient.

children.name: header_behavior
children.label: Header Behavior
children.help_text: Header position (Sticky or Static) and when to show the mobile menu at larger breakpoints.

children.name: header_position
children.label: Header Position
children.help_text: Sticky: header stays at the top of the viewport when scrolling (always visible). Static: header stays in document flow and scrolls with the page.

children.name: mobile_menu_at_xl
children.label: Use mobile menu at XL
children.help_text: When on, show the mobile (hamburger) menu at XL breakpoint instead of the horizontal desktop nav.

children.name: mobile_menu_at_lg
children.label: Use mobile menu at Desktop (LG)
children.help_text: When on, show the mobile menu at LG breakpoint instead of the horizontal desktop nav.

children.name: mobile_menu_at_md
children.label: Use mobile menu at Tablet (MD)
children.help_text: When on, show the mobile menu at MD breakpoint instead of the horizontal desktop nav.

children.name: menu_color_settings
children.label: Menu Colors
children.help_text: Colors for the main navigation links, hamburger/close icon (set separately for visibility on your header), and dropdown/submenu panels.

children.name: main_menu_color
children.label: Main menu color
children.help_text: Color for top-level menu links (in header or in the menu row below). For the hamburger and close icon, use Hamburger icon color below.

children.name: main_menu_hover_color
children.label: Main menu hover color
children.help_text: Color for top-level menu links on hover. For the hamburger/close icon hover, use Hamburger icon hover color below.

children.name: hamburger_icon_color
children.label: Hamburger icon color
children.help_text: Color for the hamburger and close icon in the header bar (and in the mobile drawer). Set independently from the menu so the icon stays visible on your header background (e.g. dark icon on light header, or light icon on dark menu row). Leave default to match the main menu color.

children.name: hamburger_icon_hover_color
children.label: Hamburger icon hover color
children.help_text: Color for the hamburger and close icon on hover.

children.name: submenu_background_color
children.label: Submenu background color
children.help_text: Background color for dropdown/submenu panels.

children.name: submenu_color
children.label: Submenu color
children.help_text: Text color for links inside dropdown/submenu panels.

children.name: submenu_hover_color
children.label: Submenu hover color
children.help_text: Text color for submenu links on hover.

children.name: menu_font_settings
children.label: Menu Fonts
children.help_text: Font and size for main-level and sub-level menu links. Defaults to theme typography when available. Desktop = horizontal menu; Mobile = when hamburger menu is enabled.

children.name: desktop_main_font
children.label: Desktop: Font (main level)
children.help_text: Desktop: top-level menu links in the horizontal nav.

children.name: desktop_main_font_size
children.label: Desktop: Font size (main level)
children.help_text: Desktop: top-level menu links (px).

children.name: desktop_sub_font
children.label: Desktop: Font (sub levels)
children.help_text: Desktop: dropdown/submenu links.

children.name: desktop_sub_font_size
children.label: Desktop: Font size (sub levels)
children.help_text: Desktop: dropdown/submenu links (px).

children.name: mobile_main_font
children.label: Mobile: Font (main level)
children.help_text: Mobile (hamburger menu): top-level menu links in the drawer.

children.name: mobile_main_font_size
children.label: Mobile: Font size (main level)
children.help_text: Mobile: top-level menu links in the drawer (px).

children.name: mobile_sub_font
children.label: Mobile: Font (sub levels)
children.help_text: Mobile: submenu links in the drawer.

children.name: mobile_sub_font_size
children.label: Mobile: Font size (sub levels)
children.help_text: Mobile: submenu links in the drawer (px).

children.name: menu_layout
children.label: Menu Layout
children.help_text: Menu alignment (left, center, or right). Option to place the menu in a full-width row below the header; when below, spacing applies to that row. Hamburger stays to the left of buttons when present, otherwise at the right of the header. When menu is below and hamburger is visible, the entire menu section is hidden.

children.name: menu_alignment
children.label: Menu Alignment
children.help_text: Align the desktop menu links left, center, or right within their area.

children.name: menu_position
children.label: Menu Position
children.help_text: In header: menu sits in the top row with logo and buttons. Below header: menu is in a full-width row under the header; spacing options apply to that row. Sticky/static follows the header setting.

children.name: menu_section_spacing
children.label: Menu Section Spacing
children.help_text: Margin and padding for the menu row when Menu position is Below header.

children.name: menu_section_background_option
children.label: Menu section & mobile background
children.help_text: Same as header: menu section and mobile drawer use the header background. Theme or custom: use a different color for the menu section (when below header) and the mobile drawer.

children.name: announcement_bar_style
children.label: Announcement Bar Style
children.help_text: Style the announcement bar. Border applies to sides and bottom only; top aligns with browser edge.

children.name: announcement_background_option
children.label: Background Option
children.help_text: Theme Color, Custom Color, or Gradient for the announcement bar.

children.name: announcement_background_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color. For a custom hex color, use Background Option = Custom Color instead.

children.name: announcement_background_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Background Option is Custom Color.

children.name: announcement_background_gradient
children.label: Background Gradient
children.help_text: Gradient when Background Option is Gradient.

children.name: announcement_text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Theme defaults uses cascade. Choose a theme color or Custom for a hex color when content sits on image/gradient/custom backgrounds.

children.name: announcement_text_color_custom
children.label: Custom Text Color
children.help_text: Hex color when Text Color is Custom.

children.name: announcement_link_context
children.label: Link Colors
children.help_text: When announcement links are on a dark background, choose Dark. When on light background, choose Light. Required when background is Custom Color since cascade cannot infer it.

children.name: announcement_border_radius_override
children.label: Override Border Radius
children.help_text: When disabled, uses the theme's global border radius. When enabled, set a custom radius. Border applies to sides and bottom only; top aligns with browser edge.

children.name: announcement_border_radius
children.label: Border Radius (px)
children.help_text: Custom border radius for sides and bottom when Override Border Radius is enabled.

children.name: announcement_height
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Fixed height of the announcement bar in pixels. Used for slide animation when opening/closing. Set to match your content (padding + text).

children.name: announcement_padding
children.label: Padding (px)
children.help_text: Padding on all four sides in pixels.

children.name: announcement_max_width
children.label: Max Width
children.help_text: Maximum width of the announcement content area. Full uses full module width; Custom lets you set a pixel value for narrower bar on large screens.

children.name: announcement_max_width_custom
children.label: Max Width (px)
children.help_text: Custom max width in pixels when Max Width is Custom.

children.name: top_bar_style
children.label: Top Bar Style
children.help_text: Style the top bar (when One or Two Columns layout is enabled). Background and spacing apply to the top bar row.

children.name: top_bar_background_option
children.label: Background Option
children.help_text: Theme Color, Custom Color, or Gradient for the top bar.

children.name: top_bar_background_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color. For a custom hex color, use Background Option = Custom Color instead.

children.name: top_bar_background_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Background Option is Custom Color.

children.name: top_bar_background_gradient
children.label: Background Gradient
children.help_text: Gradient when Background Option is Gradient.

children.name: top_bar_text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Theme defaults uses cascade. Choose a theme color or Custom for a hex color when content sits on image/gradient/custom backgrounds.

children.name: top_bar_text_color_custom
children.label: Custom Text Color
children.help_text: Hex color when Text Color is Custom.

children.name: top_bar_spacing
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Margin and padding for the top bar row.

children.name: top_bar_simple_link_font
children.label: Simple Link Font
children.help_text: Font and Link Colors for Simple Link buttons in the top bar. Link Colors applies to all top bar links (including rich text). Simple Link Font only affects buttons when Button Style is set to Simple Link.

children.name: font
children.label: Font
children.help_text: Defaults to theme typography when available.

children.name: font_size
children.label: Font Size (px)
children.help_text: Defaults to theme base font size.

children.name: link_context
children.label: Link Colors
children.help_text: When top bar links are on a dark background, choose Dark. When on light background, choose Light. Required when background is Custom Color since cascade cannot infer it.
